minor.issue: Observed one AI call returning invalid JSON parsed as 'Expecting value: line 1 column 65 (char 64)'. Second attempt succeeded. Suggest adding a lightweight retry or more lenient JSON extraction (as rust d1748 already does) in run_salt_vision.

SaltAnalyzeRequest comment still says 'full = seluruh gambar' (server.py L2757) — stale, update comment to reflect zone-only.

rca of the issue: N/A (feature add, not bug).
